title: Chili Oil Pasta & Burrata
description: A 5-ingredient creamy chili oil pasta topped with burrata. Rich, spicy, and fast enough for a weeknight — the chili crisp blooms in olive oil with garlic and onion before cream goes in to build a silky sauce.

rawText:
CAPTION (as written by the author -- trust these amounts):
5 ingredient chili oil pasta & Burrata 
Better than a restaurant! 
Super easy !! One of the most tastiest pasta you’ll ever make with just a few ingredients! 

If you like my recipes and would you like to support me click 
http://buymeacoffee.com/cookwithchn

1. 150 g pasta 
2. 1 olive oil 
3. 7-8 garlic minced 
4. 2 heaping teaspoons chili oil or chili crisp - more if you like 
5. 1 cup heavy whipping cream 
6. 1-2 cup or more pasta water
7. 1 teaspoon salt 
8. Optional garnish- chili oil / flakes and parsley 
9. 1-2 Burrata cheese garnish with parsley, chili oil, and extra olive oil

1. Cook your pasta and salt water reserve a cup of pasta water in case the sauce gets too thick you can use it to thin out. 
2. In a pan, add olive oil . 
3. Sauté onion and minced garlic on low heat. 
4. Adding your chili oil after about 30 seconds of sautéing the garlic. 
5. Immediately after adding the chili oil, you can add in the heavy whipping cream and start stirring and let the sauce start to thicken. You can add Parmesan cheese to thicken the sauce.
6. Add salt
7. Add in the pasta extra Parmesan cheese if you like stir and let everything become well incorporated keep the heat on medium otherwise the heavy cream will separate you want to cook everything on medium low heat. 
8. You can use pasta water to thin out the sauce if it gets too thick. 
9. Garnish with extra chili oil if you like it, spicy parsley and Parmesan cheese.
10. This pasta is best serve served hot.
